page.layout: One page: a blank cover of vellum or parchment with a single small dark ink stamp (a device or monogram) near the centre. No printed text.
page.notes: The scan shows the outer cover of the binding, not a printed leaf. The only mark is a dark ink stamp or emblem in the centre, which is an ownership mark and not printed text, so it is left out. Staining and spine ties are visible but are not text.
